title: Why clients choose us
lede: We keep design, drawings and site work under one roof, so what you approve is what gets built.

reasons.title: One team, start to finish
reasons.description: Designers, architects and site engineers work together, so there are no hand-offs to lose detail.

reasons.title: Fixed timelines
reasons.description: You get a dated schedule before work begins and weekly progress updates until handover.

reasons.title: Honest budgets
reasons.description: Itemised quotes with no hidden line items, planned for projects from ₹10 lakh.

reasons.title: Detail in every room
reasons.description: Material samples, mock-ups and styling are reviewed with you before anything is ordered.
